create_progress_task: create a ProgressTask via ProgressReporter.create_task with a name and total count
start_progress_task: start a ProgressTask by calling its start method to begin tracking progress
step_progress_task: step a ProgressTask forward by calling step with an optional increment value
use_noop_progress_reporter: use the NOOP_PROGRESS_REPORTER singleton as a context manager to disable progress output
implement_progress_reporter: implement a custom ProgressReporter subclass with create_task enter and exit methods
